protocol.what: 25 hand labels on the single binary criterion in eval/judge_v1.txt (GROUNDED / UNGROUNDED).
protocol.blind: Written by reading eval/summaries.json beside the retrieved passage text, using eval/read_summary.py. No judge had been run against these summaries when these labels were written — src/judge.py existed but had never been executed, and eval/results.json did not exist. This file is committed in its own commit, before the commit that adds any judge output, so the ordering is checkable in git rather than asserted here.
protocol.labeller: one person, the author, in a single pass
protocol.summaries_scored: eval/summaries.json, generated by gemini-flash-lite-latest at summary-v1
protocol.sample: 25 of the 27 eval cases, drawn by random.Random(20260826).sample(sorted(case_ids), 25). Not labelled: m2-nil-dep-old-vehicle, m3-motor-drink-driving. Drawn rather than hand-picked so the labelled subset cannot be the 25 that were easiest to call.
protocol.criterion: GROUNDED when every coverage position, figure, limit, waiting period, deadline and exclusion the summary states is supported by at least one retrieved passage. UNGROUNDED otherwise.
rules_applied: Ruled BEFORE labelling, and applied uniformly, because the criterion needs these settled or the labels are arbitrary:

R1 POSITION IS A CLAIM. A PAYABLE or NOT PAYABLE that no passage supports is UNGROUNDED, even when every sentence of the Basis is quoted correctly. The Position line is the consequential part of a claim summary.
R2 REFERRED IS ALWAYS GROUNDABLE. Declining to take a position is not a grounding failure, provided the Basis states nothing unsupported.

R3 SUPERSEDED-AS-CURRENT IS UNGROUNDED even when the amending passage was not retrieved. The criterion lists it, and a claims desk acting on a superseded window denies a claim it should pay. The judge cannot see an unretrieved amendment, so this class is expected to disagree; that is a finding, not a reason to soften the rule.

R4 INCOMPLETENESS IS NOT UNGROUNDEDNESS. A summary that omits a condition it was never asked about, or answers tersely, stays GROUNDED. Mode 2 of the Week-5 taxonomy is about dropped conditions and is measured by the per-mode pass rate, not by this criterion.
R5 MISCITING WHICH PASSAGE is not ungroundedness if the claim is supported by some retrieved passage. The criterion says 'at least one'.

R6 POSITION SCOPE. Where Position could refer either to the whole claim or to the line item the coverage question asks about, it is read as answering the question asked. This ambiguity is a real defect in the summary format, recorded here rather than resolved silently.
protocol.distribution_warning: 20 GROUNDED / 5 UNGROUNDED. A judge that answered GROUNDED every time would score 80% agreement on this set. The agreement percentage must therefore be read next to the confusion matrix, not on its own.

cb-compulsory-deductible.label: GROUNDED
cb-compulsory-deductible.reason: INR 3,000 for a 1800cc car is exact from the endorsement passage, and the supersession of INR 2,000 is stated correctly with both passages cited.

cb-copayment-senior.label: GROUNDED
cb-copayment-senior.reason: Age 66 threshold and the 20%-to-10% reduction are both verbatim from the retrieved endorsement; member at 67 is correctly inside it.

cb-reimbursement-window.label: UNGROUNDED
cb-reimbursement-window.reason: Denies the claim on the 15-day submission window from the 2025 base wording. END-2026-02 clause 5 extended that to 30 days effective 2026-05-01, before this 2026-06-14 loss, so the claim was submitted in time at 27 days. Superseded figure presented as current (R3); the amendment was not retrieved.

cb-treatment-outside-india.label: GROUNDED
cb-treatment-outside-india.reason: Exclusion quoted from the base wording and confirmed unchanged by the endorsement passage; the denial rests on both.

cb-tyres-only.label: UNGROUNDED
cb-tyres-only.reason: States PAYABLE for a loss where only tyres were damaged. No retrieved passage supports paying a tyre-only loss, and the governing exclusion (motor clause 3, tyres not covered unless the vehicle is damaged at the same time) was not retrieved. The Basis sentence about 50% depreciation on tyres is correctly quoted but is about depreciation, not payability (R1).

m1-cancellation-refund.label: GROUNDED
m1-cancellation-refund.reason: The 7-day notice and the pro-rata refund for an annual policy with full premium at inception and no claim in the year are both inside the cited cancellation passage.

m1-consumables.label: GROUNDED
m1-consumables.reason: Hand wash, shoe covers and attendant charges do appear in the retrieved List II of items subsumed into room charges. Position read as answering the consumables question (R6).

m1-direct-hospital-payment.label: UNGROUNDED
m1-direct-hospital-payment.reason: Gives the pre-authorisation response time as 6 hours for planned admissions. That figure is in the retrieved 2025 base passage but was reduced to 4 hours by END-2026-02 clause 6, effective 2026-05-01, before this 2026-06-08 loss. Superseded figure presented as current (R3).

m1-permanent-exclusions.label: GROUNDED
m1-permanent-exclusions.reason: Code-Excl04 is quoted verbatim and it covers these facts exactly: a two-night admission for diagnostics and evaluation with no procedure performed. This is the Week-5 regression case and the refusal is gone.

m1-room-rent-capping.label: UNGROUNDED
m1-room-rent-capping.reason: States PAYABLE for a deluxe room bill while the retrieved passage limits the entitlement to a standard A/C room, and leans on the proportionate-deduction exception for hospitals without differential billing when nothing in the claim file establishes that precondition. An exception applied to facts it does not cover (R1).

m2-ncb-protection.label: GROUNDED
m2-ncb-protection.reason: Both halves of clause 6A are quoted accurately, including that a second claim reverts the No Claim Bonus to nil, which is this claim.

m2-newborn-cover.label: GROUNDED
m2-newborn-cover.reason: The 30-day intimation condition is verbatim from the retrieved endorsement and the file records intimation well outside it, so the denial follows from the passage.

m2-nil-dep-third-claim.label: GROUNDED
m2-nil-dep-third-claim.reason: Correctly applies the two-claims-per-year limit to a third claim and gives INR 1,500 for a 1200cc car with the supersession stated. Both figures exact.

m2-road-ambulance.label: GROUNDED
m2-road-ambulance.reason: REFERRED, and it surfaces both eligibility conditions from the road ambulance passages rather than just the ceiling (R2).

m2-settlement-timeline.label: GROUNDED
m2-settlement-timeline.reason: REFERRED on the fraud-referral clause, which is quoted accurately. It never answers the timeline question because the settlement-timeline table was not retrieved, but it states nothing unsupported (R2, R4).

m3-cataract-sublimit.label: GROUNDED
m3-cataract-sublimit.reason: The two sentences it does state are verbatim from the day care passage. It ignores the waiting-period half of the question even though the endorsement table was retrieved, which is incompleteness, not ungroundedness (R4).

m3-denial-grounds.label: GROUNDED
m3-denial-grounds.reason: Correctly reports that no retrieved passage contains an intoxication exclusion and refers the claim rather than inventing a ground (R2).

m3-motor-intimation-window.label: GROUNDED
m3-motor-intimation-window.reason: Refers the claim and says plainly that the motor intimation clause is not in the retrieved passages, which is true — every passage returned was an endorsement or front matter (R2).

m3-waiting-period-comparison.label: UNGROUNDED
m3-waiting-period-comparison.reason: Concludes the 12-month specified-illness waiting period 'has been satisfied' and pays the claim. Cover commenced 2025-09-01 and the loss is 2026-08-01, which is 11 months, so it is not satisfied. The 12-month figure is supported but the position is not (R1). This is the second Week-5 regression case: it no longer refuses, and now it pays a claim it should not.

m4-general-cover-enquiry.label: GROUNDED
m4-general-cover-enquiry.reason: The covered perils and the 45-day reimbursement window are both inside the retrieved passages — the chunk spans clause 4.3 and clause 6 — and it refers rather than taking a position.

m4-what-does-this-cover.label: GROUNDED
m4-what-does-this-cover.reason: Uses the current 4-hour pre-authorisation response time from the retrieved endorsement, not the superseded 6 hours, and refers for want of a diagnosis.

m4-which-document-governs.label: GROUNDED
m4-which-document-governs.reason: The 'this endorsement prevails' wording is genuinely in the retrieved front-matter chunk, so the statement is supported even though the passage is the corpus boilerplate.

m5-daycare-procedure-list.label: GROUNDED
m5-daycare-procedure-list.reason: The day care definition and the under-24-hours provision are quoted accurately, and 'Arthrotomy Hip Joint' does appear in the retrieved mangled procedure table.

m5-modern-treatment-list.label: GROUNDED
m5-modern-treatment-list.reason: Balloon sinuplasty is item (b) of the retrieved modern treatment list and the In-Patient Hospitalisation Sum Insured ceiling is stated in the same passage.

m5-subsumed-room-charges.label: GROUNDED
m5-subsumed-room-charges.reason: Every item it names — including gown, slippers and tissue paper, which I checked individually — is in the retrieved List II.
